spec.title: Small talk at a party
spec.setting: A friend's birthday party in a flat in Tai Koo. You don't know many people.

character.name: Wing
character.personality: curious, easygoing, asks lots of questions
character.speech_style: relaxed, friendly, uses 呀 and 咩

spec.goal: Introduce yourself, say what you do, and find one thing you both like.
spec.opener_hint: Wing says hi and asks how you know the birthday girl.
